content: $\bullet $ Key-guided Hierarchical Attention. This variant follows the intuition that once an entity is chosen for mention (thanks to $\alpha _{i,t}$), only the type of records is important to determine the content of the description. For example, when deciding to mention a player, all experts automatically report his score without consideration of its specific value. To test this intuition, we model the attention scores by computing the $\beta _{i,j,t}$ scores from equation (SECREF16) solely on the embedding of the key rather than on the full record representation $\mathbf {h}_{i,j}$:
